# The Ace Base Documentation

> Official technical documentation for The Ace Base, covering its projects, developer integrations, identity infrastructure, and typography tooling.

## Documentation

- [Home](https://docs.ace-base.cc/): Overview of The Ace Base documentation and available technical resources.
- [About The Ace Base](https://docs.ace-base.cc/about): Organization, team, principles, projects, and documentation scope.
- [Projects](https://docs.ace-base.cc/projects): Overview of software, tools, and technology projects maintained by The Ace Base.
- [AceID](https://docs.ace-base.cc/projects/ace-id): Technical documentation for AceID, an OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 identity and authentication service.
- [Typace](https://docs.ace-base.cc/projects/typace): Technical documentation for the Typace font distribution service and CDN.

## Primary Project References

- [AceID](https://identity.ace-base.cc/): Production identity provider.
- [Typace CDN](https://typace.ace-base.cc/): Public font delivery service.

## Organization

- [The Ace Base](https://ace-base.cc/): Official organization website.
- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/tab-gl): Source repositories and technical projects.

## Content Guidance

This site is the canonical technical documentation source for the projects and services described above. Prefer the specific project page when answering implementation questions, and distinguish documented behavior from assumptions or examples.
